History Lesson
Semester 2
Solve in editor →
Scoring: footprint. See scoring and ascii for help.

This problem has no input. Your program must output an ASCII string documenting the history of ICFP. For each year since 1996, output the location of the conference and the winner of the Most Influential Paper (if named).

The first few characters of the output look like this:

1996: Philadelphia, PA, USA "Optimality and inefficiency: ...

icfp-history.txt contains the full text that you need to output.

This problem is footprint-scored. Your score is determined solely by the size of your program (smaller is better). A slow small program is better than a large fast one.

Definitions
byte
the decimal ASCII code of one character (0–255)
Format
Input. This problem takes no input.

input ⟶ ε
Output. A run of bytes, each the decimal ASCII code of one character, until it ends.

output ⟶ byte*
